author: ViceTechnicolour
body:
A map by  ApolloIsFunky and  Spidercell for the Capture the Wool gamemode. This map is a 16v16, and has team colors of green vs. yellow. There are two wool rooms, and you have 1 spawn per team. This map is intended to be a mix of a more open Deepwind Jungle.




A download will not be given out.
